title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders: Freight Rebooking Fee Calculation
content:
**Pricing statement - Large Item Freight Delivery rebooking fee, Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

The rebooking fee is the effective booking fee plus the crew surcharge, multiplied by the member rate and then by the open-order factor, rounded half up to the cent once at the end. The booking fee is the Large Item Freight Delivery redelivery fee and is charged as it stands, with no crew surcharge, a member rate of 1 and an open-order factor of 1.

## The parts of the fee

| Part | Value |
|---|---|
| Booking fee, charged as it stands | The redelivery fee of Large Item Freight Delivery, from the method's carrier terms |
| Crew surcharge | None |
| Member rate | 1 |
| Open-order factor | 1 |

## Grouping and rounding

- The booking fee and the crew surcharge are added first.
- That sum is multiplied by the member rate, and the product by the open-order factor.
- The figure is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; no intermediate figure is rounded.

## Worked example

With the Large Item Freight Delivery redelivery fee of $49.00: ($49.00 plus nothing) multiplied by 1 and then by 1 is $49.00, which is the rebooking fee the customer pays.
